Dear Jennifer,
Thank you for your enthusiasm about the Frontend Engineer position at CloudVault Technologies! As the next step in our interview process, we'd like you to complete a code assignment that will help us better understand your approach to problem-solving and code quality.
Assignment Overview:
You'll be tasked with building a React-based task management application with the following requirements:

Create a component that allows users to add, edit, and delete tasks
Implement filtering functionality (All, Active, Completed)
Store task data in local state (no backend API required)
Use modern CSS or a CSS framework (Tailwind, Material-UI, etc.) for styling
Ensure the code is clean, well-documented, and follows React best practices

Submission Guidelines:

Time Limit: 3-4 hours (no need to rush—quality over speed)
Deadline: Please submit by Friday, March 7th, 2025 at 11:59 PM EST
Deliverables: Push your code to a GitHub repository and send us the link
Setup: Use Create React App or your preferred setup tool

How to Submit:
Reply to this email with:

A link to your GitHub repository
Instructions on how to run the project locally
Any notes about your approach or decisions

Questions?
If you need clarification on the assignment requirements or run into any technical issues, don't hesitate to reach out. I'm happy to help!
We're excited to see what you create. Best of luck, and we look forward to reviewing your work!
Best regards,
David Park
Engineering Lead
CloudVault Technologies
